name: Atelier
for: an architecture, interiors, landscape or design studio showing its work
description: A strict grid and big numerals: the practice in one sentence, an index of projects with place, year and status, three featured projects drawn as plans, how the studio works, and a contact block. Black on paper with one signal red; dark mode is a lightbox.

images.prompt: An architectural photograph of a low timber house on a sloping meadow at dusk, interior lights on, wide lens, calm and precise, no people
Interior photograph of a small public library reading room with tall north light, oak shelving and a concrete floor, empty, symmetrical
Photograph of a brick courtyard housing block with planted terraces, overcast light, seen from the courtyard corner
